label: Aquinas I q.7 a.2 co. supports Whatever is not INFINITE_1 has a non-maximal degree of act
note: Received and contracted being gives a reason the created case lacks absolute infinity. The premise ranges over every non-INFINITE_1 bearer and requires failure to be a top element in a common act preorder. It still needs the extension to those bearers and the link from contraction of esse to non-maximal act.
